## Overview

This is a legacy script from the earlier all-site analysis (primary tumours plus metastatic biopsies from bone, lymph node and soft tissue). It is included for transparency and is not part of the bone-only pipeline. In each of the six archival and pre-treatment strata, it tested non-responders against responders at AOI level with limma-voom. Patient was treated as a blocking factor through two-pass `duplicateCorrelation` with `voomWithQualityWeights`, and the RUV-4 factors from phase3 were included as covariates. Models with and without the RUV covariates were compared, and a pseudobulk-by-patient model was run on one stratum (archival CD45⁺) as a cross-check of the blocking approach.

These AOI-level results produced the large gene counts reported earlier. The current analysis re-evaluates them at patient level (Extended Data Fig. 8a). Its frozen top tables with RUV covariates (`data/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/*_toptable_with_RUV.csv`) are read by comp_18.

**Figures, tables and results supported**

- Extended Data Fig. 8a (earlier AOI-level gene counts at FDR < 0.05), via comp_18 reading the frozen `data/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/*_toptable_with_RUV.csv`
- Results: Re-evaluation of earlier neuroendocrine, purity and bone-niche findings

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --legacy` (optional; not needed to reproduce the current analysis, whose frozen inputs are in `data/previous_analysis/`). Approximate runtime: minutes to tens of minutes (two-pass duplicateCorrelation per model).

**Inputs**

- `results_legacy/phase3_ruv_results.rds`

**Outputs**

- `results_legacy/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/*_toptable_with_RUV.csv (frozen copies in data/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/)`
- `results_legacy/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/*_toptable_without_RUV.csv`
- `results_legacy/previous_analysis/Phase4_DE/*_{pval_hist_with_vs_without,volcano,MA}.pdf`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase4_DE/CD45__Archival_toptable_pseudobulk.csv`
- `results_legacy/phase4_de_results.rds`
- `results_legacy/phase4_summary_table.csv`

**Depends on**: `phase3_normalization`

## Analysis

### Legacy AOI-level differential expression

The header describes the contrast, how the intermediate group was handled, the RUV sensitivity comparison and patient blocking.

Sets the working directory to `results_legacy/` and loads the phase3 results. `run_limma_voom()` builds a cell-means design `~ 0 + response group`, optionally with RUV factors W. It applies TMM, then voom, estimates the intra-patient correlation, refits with `voomWithQualityWeights` and re-estimates the correlation. It then fits the blocked model, forms the non-responder − responder contrast and applies robust eBayes.

```{r phase4-DE-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE Trial GeoMx DSP -- Phase 4: Differential Expression
##
## Primary contrast (Q1): Non_Responder vs Responder, within each of the 6
## Phase 3 strata (segment x {Archival, Screening}). Intermediate is retained
## as its own coefficient where present (not tested) rather than dropped, to
## match the starter Rmd's ~0+bio / NRvsR contrast convention. Excluded
## entirely for PSMA+ (see phase3b -- Intermediate is 100% aliased with
## study_batch there, so it was dropped upstream of normalization already).
##
## Per user instruction: test RUV-4(/RUV-III-PRPS) W covariates + limma-voom
## (already the pattern in Prince_Archival_CD45.Rmd), and COMPARE the DE
## results with vs without the RUV covariates as a sensitivity check, before
## proceeding to downstream analysis (Phase 5+).
##
## Nesting: multiple ROIs/AOIs per patient are not independent (see master
## plan's "ROI-nesting trap"). Primary approach = limma duplicateCorrelation
## with patient (subject_id) as a blocking factor, 2-pass as in the starter
## Rmd. Cross-validated against a pseudobulk-by-patient approach on one
## representative stratum (CD45+/Archival) per the master plan's requirement.
## ============================================================================

suppressMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr)
  library(edgeR); library(limma); library(ggplot2)
})

PRINCE_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."))
RAW_DIR <- file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "data", "interim")     # all-site QC'd objects written by comp_00a_qc
dir.create(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"), showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"))           # legacy outputs; frozen copies used downstream are in data/previous_analysis
dir.create("Results/Phase4_DE", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

phase3 <- readRDS("phase3_ruv_results.rds")

get_W <- function(entry) {
  if (!is.null(entry$W)) return(entry$W)
  aname <- paste0("RUVIIIprps_k_", entry$chosen_k)
  entry$se@metadata$RUVIII$W[[aname]]
}

run_limma_voom <- function(counts, bio, pid, W = NULL, contrast_name = "NRvsR") {
  design_base <- model.matrix(~0 + bio)
  colnames(design_base) <- make.names(colnames(design_base))
  if (!is.null(W)) {
    colnames(W) <- paste0("W", seq_len(ncol(W)))
    design <- cbind(design_base, W)
  } else {
    design <- design_base
  }
  dge <- DGEList(counts)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
  v1 <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
  dupcor1 <- duplicateCorrelation(v1, design, block = pid)
  v2 <- voomWithQualityWeights(dge, design, block = pid, correlation = dupcor1$consensus, plot = FALSE)
  dupcor2 <- duplicateCorrelation(v2, design, block = pid)
  fit <- lmFit(v2, design, block = pid, correlation = dupcor2$consensus)
  bio_cols <- colnames(design_base)
  # NRvsR contrast: Non_Responder - Responder (robust to exact make.names spelling)
  nr_col <- bio_cols[grepl("Non_Responder", bio_cols)]
  r_col  <- bio_cols[grepl("^bioResponder$|Responder$", bio_cols) & !grepl("Non_Responder", bio_cols)]
  stopifnot(length(nr_col) == 1, length(r_col) == 1)
  cm <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(nr_col, " - ", r_col), levels = design)
  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cm)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, robust = TRUE)
  tt <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  list(fit = fit2, toptable = tt, design = design, consensus = dupcor2$consensus)
}

summary_rows <- list()
de_results <- list()

```

### Per-stratum fits

For each stratum the script fits the model with and without RUV covariates. It counts genes at FDR < 0.05 and their overlap, estimates π₀ (convest), saves P-value histograms, volcano and MA plots, and writes both top tables. Patient numbers per response group are printed because the patient, not the AOI, is the true sample size.

```{r phase4-DE-02}
for (stratum_id in names(phase3)) {
  entry <- phase3[[stratum_id]]
  cat("\n\n================ DE STRATUM:", stratum_id, "(", entry$segment, "/", entry$timepoint, ") ================\n")

  cd <- entry$cd
  counts <- assay(entry$se, "all_count")
  bio <- droplevels(factor(cd$response_group_neat))
  pid <- factor(cd$subject_id)
  cat("Response levels in this stratum:", paste(levels(bio), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  n_by_group <- cd %>% distinct(subject_id, response_group_neat) %>% count(response_group_neat)
  cat("Patients per response group (true n, not AOI n):\n"); print(as.data.frame(n_by_group))
  cat("N AOIs:", ncol(entry$se), " N patients:", length(unique(cd$subject_id)), "\n")

  W <- get_W(entry)
  cat("W dim (RUV covariates, chosen k =", entry$chosen_k, "):", paste(dim(W), collapse = "x"), "\n")

  fit_with <- run_limma_voom(counts, bio, pid, W = W)
  fit_without <- run_limma_voom(counts, bio, pid, W = NULL)

  n_sig_with <- sum(fit_with$toptable$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  n_sig_without <- sum(fit_without$toptable$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  sig_with <- rownames(fit_with$toptable)[fit_with$toptable$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  sig_without <- rownames(fit_without$toptable)[fit_without$toptable$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  overlap <- length(intersect(sig_with, sig_without))
  cat("DE genes (FDR<0.05) WITH RUV covariates:", n_sig_with, "\n")
  cat("DE genes (FDR<0.05) WITHOUT RUV covariates:", n_sig_without, "\n")
  cat("Overlap:", overlap, "\n")

  pi0_with <- tryCatch(limma::propTrueNull(fit_with$toptable$P.Value, method = "convest"), error = function(e) NA)
  pi0_without <- tryCatch(limma::propTrueNull(fit_without$toptable$P.Value, method = "convest"), error = function(e) NA)
  cat("pi0 (proportion null) with covariates:", round(pi0_with, 3), " without:", round(pi0_without, 3), "\n")

  # diagnostic plots: p-value histograms + volcano (with-covariates model, primary)
  p_hist <- ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(aes(x = fit_with$toptable$P.Value, fill = "with RUV covariates"), alpha = 0.5, bins = 40) +
    geom_histogram(aes(x = fit_without$toptable$P.Value, fill = "without RUV covariates"), alpha = 0.5, bins = 40) +
    theme_bw() + labs(title = paste("P-value histogram:", stratum_id), x = "p-value", fill = "")
  ggsave(file.path("Results/Phase4_DE", paste0(stratum_id, "_pval_hist_with_vs_without.pdf")), p_hist, width = 7, height = 4.5)

  vp <- fit_with$toptable
  vp$sig <- vp$adj.P.Val < 0.05
  p_volcano <- ggplot(vp, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), color = sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) + theme_bw() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "firebrick")) +
    labs(title = paste("Volcano (NRvsR, with RUV covariates):", stratum_id), color = "FDR<0.05")
  ggsave(file.path("Results/Phase4_DE", paste0(stratum_id, "_volcano.pdf")), p_volcano, width = 6, height = 5)

  ma <- ggplot(vp, aes(AveExpr, logFC, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw() + scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "firebrick")) +
    labs(title = paste("MA plot (NRvsR, with RUV covariates):", stratum_id), color = "FDR<0.05")
  ggsave(file.path("Results/Phase4_DE", paste0(stratum_id, "_MA.pdf")), ma, width = 6, height = 5)

  write.csv(fit_with$toptable, file.path("Results/Phase4_DE", paste0(stratum_id, "_toptable_with_RUV.csv")))
  write.csv(fit_without$toptable, file.path("Results/Phase4_DE", paste0(stratum_id, "_toptable_without_RUV.csv")))

  de_results[[stratum_id]] <- list(fit_with = fit_with, fit_without = fit_without,
                                    bio = bio, pid = pid, counts = counts)
  summary_rows[[stratum_id]] <- data.frame(
    stratum = stratum_id, segment = entry$segment, timepoint = entry$timepoint,
    n_aoi = ncol(entry$se), n_patients = length(unique(cd$subject_id)),
    n_patients_NR = n_by_group$n[n_by_group$response_group_neat == "Non_Responder"],
    n_patients_R = n_by_group$n[n_by_group$response_group_neat == "Responder"],
    n_sig_with_RUV = n_sig_with, n_sig_without_RUV = n_sig_without, overlap = overlap,
    pi0_with = round(pi0_with, 3), pi0_without = round(pi0_without, 3)
  )
}

```

Collects and prints the per-stratum summary.

```{r phase4-DE-03}
summary_tab <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
cat("\n\n================ PHASE 4 SUMMARY ACROSS STRATA ================\n")
print(summary_tab, row.names = FALSE)

```

### Blocking versus pseudobulk cross-check

In archival CD45⁺, counts are summed per patient and the RUV factors averaged per patient. The script fits limma-voom on the pseudobulk and compares it with the blocked AOI-level fit: number of genes at FDR < 0.05, overlap of the top 500 genes and logFC correlation. All results are saved.

```{r phase4-DE-04}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Nesting cross-validation: duplicateCorrelation vs pseudobulk-by-patient
## on CD45+/Archival (representative, well-behaved RUV-4 stratum)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n\n================ NESTING CROSS-VALIDATION: CD45+/Archival ================\n")
entry <- phase3[["CD45__Archival"]]
cd <- entry$cd
counts <- assay(entry$se, "all_count")
bio <- droplevels(factor(cd$response_group_neat))
pid <- factor(cd$subject_id)
W <- get_W(entry)

# pseudobulk: sum counts per patient (within this segment+timepoint stratum)
pb_groups <- split(seq_len(ncol(counts)), pid)
pb_counts <- sapply(pb_groups, function(idx) rowSums(counts[, idx, drop = FALSE]))
pb_bio <- sapply(pb_groups, function(idx) as.character(bio[idx[1]]))
pb_bio <- droplevels(factor(pb_bio, levels = levels(bio)))
# pseudobulk W: average W across each patient's AOIs
pb_W <- t(sapply(pb_groups, function(idx) colMeans(W[idx, , drop = FALSE])))
colnames(pb_W) <- paste0("W", seq_len(ncol(pb_W)))

cat("Pseudobulk: N patients =", ncol(pb_counts), "\n")
design_pb <- model.matrix(~0 + pb_bio)
colnames(design_pb) <- make.names(colnames(design_pb))
design_pb_full <- cbind(design_pb, pb_W)
dge_pb <- DGEList(pb_counts); dge_pb <- calcNormFactors(dge_pb, method = "TMM")
v_pb <- voom(dge_pb, design_pb_full, plot = FALSE)
fit_pb <- lmFit(v_pb, design_pb_full)
nr_col <- colnames(design_pb)[grepl("Non_Responder", colnames(design_pb))]
r_col  <- colnames(design_pb)[grepl("Responder", colnames(design_pb)) & !grepl("Non_Responder", colnames(design_pb))]
cm_pb <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(nr_col, " - ", r_col), levels = design_pb_full)
fit_pb2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_pb, cm_pb), robust = TRUE)
tt_pb <- topTable(fit_pb2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")

tt_dupcor <- de_results[["CD45__Archival"]]$fit_with$toptable
n_sig_dupcor <- sum(tt_dupcor$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
n_sig_pb <- sum(tt_pb$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(tt_dupcor), rownames(tt_pb))
overlap_top500 <- length(intersect(
  rownames(tt_dupcor)[order(tt_dupcor$P.Value)][1:min(500, nrow(tt_dupcor))],
  rownames(tt_pb)[order(tt_pb$P.Value)][1:min(500, nrow(tt_pb))]
))
logfc_cor <- cor(tt_dupcor[common_genes, "logFC"], tt_pb[common_genes, "logFC"])

cat("DE genes (FDR<0.05): duplicateCorrelation =", n_sig_dupcor, " | pseudobulk =", n_sig_pb, "\n")
cat("Overlap of top 500 genes by p-value between methods:", overlap_top500, "/ 500\n")
cat("Correlation of logFC estimates between methods (shared genes):", round(logfc_cor, 3), "\n")

write.csv(tt_pb, "Results/Phase4_DE/CD45__Archival_toptable_pseudobulk.csv")

saveRDS(list(de_results = de_results, summary_table = summary_tab,
             nesting_crossval = list(tt_dupcor = tt_dupcor, tt_pb = tt_pb,
                                      n_sig_dupcor = n_sig_dupcor, n_sig_pb = n_sig_pb,
                                      overlap_top500 = overlap_top500, logfc_cor = logfc_cor)),
        "phase4_de_results.rds")
write.csv(summary_tab, "phase4_summary_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nSaved phase4_de_results.rds, phase4_summary_table.csv, and per-stratum",
    "topTables/plots under Results/Phase4_DE/\n")
cat("Phase 4 script complete.\n")
```
